title: feat(studio): package-level draft publish (not per-item)
body:
## Why

Publishing is a formal draft→live switch, so it should confirm & release the **whole package's** drafts at once — not object-by-object. The pillar Studio was doing per-item `client.publish(...)` (and the Data grid even **auto-published** on every column drag), which the platform already models better.

## What

Reuses the platform's existing package-publish machinery (`usePublishAllDrafts` → `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`, structure-before-seeds + ADR-0038 L3 probes; orphans by-reference) and moves publish to the shell top bar:

- **Top bar**: pending-draft **count** + **变更** (Changes review = `DraftChangesPanel`) + one **发布** that publishes all pending drafts in one governed pass.
- **Per-pillar 发布 buttons removed**; **保存草稿** stays — edits accumulate as drafts.
- **Data grid drag-reorder no longer auto-publishes** — it saves a draft like every other edit.
- After publish, pillars re-read the fresh published baseline (publish nonce); a draft-save refreshes the count.

## Verified in-browser (`/studio/com.example.showcase`)

Verified via a **flow** (object drafts are gated by `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` on this backend): 保存草稿 → **变更 · 1** + Publish enabled → **发布** → `/api/v1/meta/_drafts` = **0**. Per-item 发布 gone from all three pillars. `type-check`: 0 errors in the changed file.

## Note

Drafts carry no reliable `packageId` (flow overlay reports `null`), so we count/publish **all** pending — in the single-package Studio that is exactly this app's build. Server-side per-package scoping is a follow-up.
